note: Written on 2026-10-29 before the routing fix, from requests in the private distillation notes. A positive passes when the brief selects one of `any` (a play counts). `allowEmpty` cases name a platform and may return a platform-only brief, which must load the named channel facts. Negatives are engineering requests that share words with the new phrases and must stay silent. Quoted text and the word 'example' are context to the router by design, so these requests are written without quotes.
